title: OnePlus TV (Y Series 43", Skyworth-built SW1, codename shibuya), Android TV 11 (API 30), firmware RTO9.231122.002
header:
OnePlus TV (Y Series 43", Skyworth-built SW1, codename shibuya), Android TV 11 (API 30), firmware RTO9.231122.002
Vendor fingerprint OnePlus/OnePlus_Y_Series/shibuya:11/RTO9.231122.002/11136549. armeabi-v7a, UI at 1280x720, ~0.9 GB RAM.
Classic Android TV home, not Google TV: the stock launcher is com.google.android.tvlauncher.

Stock launcher:  com.google.android.tvlauncher
Live TV app:     com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter  (Live TV tuner and HDMI input panel; keep it)

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/oneplus-tv-y1/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/oneplus-tv-y1/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Disabled before this debloat, so not listed (restore.sh would turn it ON): com.google.android.marvin.talkback.

Status: disabled on one TV on 2026-10-18 and lived with through 2026-10-20 without trouble; checked with
remote-key injection and screenshots (stock home, Live TV tuner via com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter, HDMI input
switching, Bluetooth voice remote, audio, and launcher/ installed as Home). Unlike the Panasonic list on the
same Skyworth platform, com.coocaa.factory and com.mediatek.tv.factory were disabled and lived with for several
days without side effects.

Kept on purpose: Google Assistant (com.google.android.katniss), Chromecast
(com.google.android.apps.mediashell), Google Play Services, Bluetooth Remote &
Gboard (LatinIME). Live TV tuner uses com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter.
